name: dex_token_trade_dashboard
description: Get exchange-style token trade dashboard data including current price, 24h change, high/low, volume, market cap, and supply metrics. Use asset_id when known, or token for a symbol/name search.

token.description: Token symbol, name, or CoinGecko-style asset identifier such as BTC, ETH, SOL, or bitcoin.

asset_id.description: CoinGecko asset identifier when already known, such as bitcoin or ethereum.

vs_currency.description: Quote currency for the trade dashboard. Defaults to usd.
